design: Adversarial / minimax self-play against a market generator (robust RL): policy pi (per-asset daily weight vector) vs generator G over a plausibility set U (RARL/Spooner drift-knob adversary; Wasserstein-DRO ball; PAIRED regret with TASK_110's hindsight oracle; Bella domain randomisation), objective max_pi min_{P in U} E_P[U(net PnL at fee16/slip5)], with the learned G then offered to Monte Carlo search as the leaf/rollout distribution ("patterns that serve Monte Carlo").

Literature: Spooner & Savani 2020 (arXiv 2003.01820v2) read in full (7 pp, PDF) — Table 1a/1c and Theorem 1 numbers as quoted by the proposal CONFIRMED (FIXED-trained RN: 67.0±12.0, Sharpe 5.57, inventory 0.56±7.55; STRATEGIC b,A,k: 65.1±6.7, Sharpe 9.78, inventory −0.05±1.94; b-only 9.51; +98.1%/+86.0% variance; Thm 1 b*=b_low if H>0, b_high if H<0; "strategies that try to avoid trading at all, a frequent problem in this domain" p.6; paper is SINGLE-asset, multi-asset listed as future work). Blanchet, Chen & Zhou 2018 (arXiv 1802.04885v1) read pp.1-12 (PDF) — Prop. 1 eq.(5), Theorem 1 eq.(9), §3.1 "If δ is too large ... the resulting optimal portfolios will tend to be just equal allocations", δ_n = O(n^-1), RWPI at 1−δ0 typically 95% — all CONFIRMED; note the paper's equal-allocation limit is under the budget constraint φ^T 1 = 1 (eq. 1), so the proposal's "flat" limit for an unconstrained cost-charged long-short book is its own (correct) extrapolation of Prop. 1, not the paper's stated result. Goalposts checked literally against docs/pathway.md:9-21.
strongest_objection: The design fails the goalposts by construction, not by measurement, and the repo already contains every number needed to see it. (1) docs/pathway.md:9-21 requires, on unseen years at fee16/slip5, net@21 > +0.97, "holds positions (no HOLD collapse)", and BEAR-positive. The minimax fixed point over any U that contains a zero-drift or drift-mirrored member is flat (Prop. 1: worst-case mean of φ is E_{P_n}[φ^T R] − √δ‖φ‖_p, so with cost c(φ)>0 every non-zero φ has worst-case EV ≤ −c(φ) once √δ ≥ ‖μ̂‖_q); flat violates "holds positions" outright and has bear PnL exactly 0, not >0. Under a long-only budget constraint the limit is equal allocation (Blanchet §3.1), which is ALREADY MEASURED on the PIT 273-asset panel as the scorer's B&H column (trader/backtest.py:225-227 = daily EW over present assets, zero turnover): gross −0.40 FULL, −2.54 BEAR22, −2.28 BEAR18, −0.29 BULL24, −1.63 CHOP25 (runs/819_single_asset/POWERED_RESULT.md:44-46) — fails BEAR-positive in every bear on record. (2) The only way to make the robust book non-flat is to shrink U so that some direction has estimated drift exceeding √δ plus cost — i.e. to assert a forecast with a t-statistic. That object is exactly the direction memo's G-A gate (lore/fable_direction_memo_2026-09-03.md:305-306: IC ≥ 0.02, NW t ≥ 3, positive in 2024/2025/2026H1), which the memo says has never been measured on this panel (memo §1.3, §4.7). So the loop's output is fully determined by a number the program does not have, and running the loop cannot produce that number: G is fitted to the same OHLC panel and its drift channel is a lower-sample-efficiency forecaster. (3) For the "serve Monte Carlo" half: the record locates ALL measured search value in TRUE-environment lookahead — 831x/C (LEDGER:52) R=1 true leaf +1.95 vs ref +0.751, R=3 +5.29; E5-inversion3 (:81) +8.024 with a true-env leaf on the same weights that score −6.92 with a learned leaf; 849/leaf (:74) learned v̂ carries +0.03 action information; 879 (:93) learned-leaf search is subtractive vs argmax (Δ1.602, 5.4% → 94.1% hold); 861 (:90) the +8.118 search teacher yields a WORSE BC student (median +0.692 vs +0.991). A generator leaf cannot supply lookahead; its only channel to value is its conditional drift at horizon R, bounded above by the best forecaster's IC at that horizon. If that IC is ~0 (the memo's load-bearing doubt), a Bella/G leaf is the 849 noise leaf and the search is the 879 subtractive wrapper. Nothing in the design escapes any of these mechanically; the proposal's own escape ("the instrument outside the loop") concedes the point. (4) The Spooner–Savani result the design leans on is the clean demonstration AGAINST it: robustness moved terminal wealth 67.0 → 65.1 (mean FELL) while std fell 12.0 → 6.7; their MM keeps a positive mean only from spread income, which a daily spot directional book does not have, and their model is single-asset with no transaction costs beyond the spread model (Table 1, pp.5-6, read in full).
amplifier_check: Verdict: AMPLIFIER ONLY — and in this family a de-amplifier (position shrinker). Reasoning: the loop learns two objects. G_adv is a reweighting of paths toward the policy's worst cases; the information it carries is about pi (where pi is fragile), a function of the policy, not of the market — any generator fitted to the OHLC panel holds no conditional-mean information the panel does not, and a supervised forecaster on the same panel extracts that mean with strictly higher sample efficiency than a generator's drift channel (memo §5, encoder_bella_class_closed.md:29 both say this in the repo's own words). The robust pi* is, in closed form (Prop. 1 / Thm. 1, verified), the nominal forecast shrunk by a confidence radius: a t-stat gate on μ̂. The only genuinely new input is U itself, which is a designer-supplied prior; if U encodes a directional tilt, the "information" was put in by hand and is a forecast that must pass G-A on its own. What the loop CAN carry beyond a mean forecaster is second-moment/path structure (vol clustering, correlation regimes, tail shape) — real, and a generator can hold it — but that serves variance, drawdown and sizing (tactics panel row 4, 1–2%), not expectation; 804's candle LM already showed real order-dependent structure (7.61 vs 8.19 bits/tok) that did not convert to alpha. Repo cross-checks: 892 (LEDGER:102) shows the imprint's OOS anti-edge lives in maintenance re-trims — a robust loop would suppress those, which is cost reduction (panel row 2), not created expectation; 861 shows a strictly better target (+8.1 teacher) does not amplify into a better student, so even the amplification direction is unreliable on this stack. Worth if daily IC ≈ 0: exactly zero alpha (pi* flat or EW, both measured negative-or-zero above), positive residual value only as a stress/sizing/null-distribution tool.

surviving_claim: Nothing survives as a source of edge or as a route to the goalposts. What survives is bounded and downstream of a forecast that does not yet exist: (1) the Wasserstein-DRO shrinkage as a closed-form sizing/gating rule — trade only where μ̂^T φ − √δ‖φ‖_p − cost > 0 with δ from RWPI at 95% — to be folded into the memo's Gârleanu–Pedersen book (memo §4.2) or tactics panel row 4 IF G-A ever passes; CPU, no loop, +0 expected Sharpe, some variance reduction; (2) the cheap adversary as the NULL FAMILY for the IC instrument — circular block bootstrap of dates, blockwise time-reversal, global market-residual reflection of the PIT panel — replacing the 819 CAPACITY 'max of four shuffles' floor (memo E-2, cap_aggregate.py:46-57) inside the G-A SPEC; this is the one concrete artifact of the proposal worth adopting, and it belongs in experiments/9xx_ic_ceiling, not in a loop; (3) Bella's already-sanctioned R4 stress-generator role (D5; pathway.md:84-85) — at minute scale as trained, or after a separate daily-trained build; (4) the correct diagnosis that a self-learning loop's daily-surface output is decided entirely by whether the daily conditional-mean IC clears ~0.02–0.03 (memo §1.3), so no GPU — 24 GB or 64 GB — should be spent in this family before the ≤2-CPU-day IC instrument reports. Answer to the operator's question, without flattery: no self-learning loop that learns patterns to serve Monte Carlo evaluation can create information the panel lacks; the only loop-shaped object the record has not falsified (Bella as MCTS leaf, TASK_778, never built) inherits the same bound and the same 849/879 failure mode if IC ≈ 0.
kill_experiment_critique: The proposed ambiguity-radius sweep should not be run as a kill experiment because both of its gates return the 'expected' outcome regardless of what is true. P1 (U3 selector picks flat/s=0) is a tautology: the global residual-reflection member makes every residual L/S tactic's return distribution symmetric about −cost, so the 10th-percentile (or min) selector chooses flat by algebra on ANY data — Prop. 1 already says this without a run; a test that cannot fail is a demonstration, not a kill, and its 'GPU loop killed' inference is available today from the closed form. P2 (some intermediate radius selects a non-flat tactic whose realised unseen 2026H1 net@21 beats both nominal and flat by more than the bootstrap CI half-width) is underpowered by construction: the unseen slice is ≤6 months (≤3 months via the cited data.py:190 path, see record_conflicts), and 898's own 2026H1 bootstrap CIs on this scorer are ≈±3 Sharpe wide (baseline [−5.30,+0.95], variant [−7.89,−2.09], LEDGER:103), so P2 demands a ~3-point Sharpe margin in half a year — it fails by power, not by content. Further defects: (a) the 8 tactics × 4 sizes × 3 radii = 96 selection cells with 'positive in 2024 and 2025' in-sample to the selection need Bonferroni over the grid, unstated; (b) the U4 Bella arm is not constructible from the resident checkpoint (one day per window, data_loader.py:150-197); (c) the tactic-library-by-year scoring IS tactics panel row 1 (already proposed, minutes of CPU) and the surrogate wrapper IS honest use (3) — the 'robust selector' layer adds a known answer on top of two rows that already exist. What to keep: build the surrogate null family (block bootstrap, blockwise time-reversal, global residual reflection — implemented once, covariance-preserving as the proposal's open doubt 5 flags) as the null distribution inside the IC-ceiling SPEC (memo §4.3–4.4), scored with the unmodified trader.backtest.cell_metrics (backtest.py:230) and read_ohlcv_daily (data.py:266) under 898's epoch gate; record the minimax closure as a one-paragraph DECISIONS/LEDGER note citing Prop. 1 and this panel rather than a run. If the operator still wants a run on record for closure, run only P1's U0/U1 tactic-library scoring (= panel row 1) and print the DRO-shrunk sizing beside each tactic as a disclosed column — CPU minutes, no gate claimed.
